name: showcase
title: Showcase: dashboard, server detail, studio, modpacks
docs: Showcase screenshot plan. Captures are CROPS of each page's content column (no sidebar or topbar chrome) on a seeded stack with a RUNNING server and a populated modpack library (see devstack.sh seed + seed_showcase_pack). Capturing the whole content column keeps every PNG at a comparable 4:3-16:10 ratio instead of thin strips, so the landing tour can show them large. Crops render at 2x for crisp marketing use. Element shots clip a viewport screenshot to the measured box (locator-level element shots have rendered CSS-var-themed content wrong). Regen: boot a disposable seeded stack with scripts/review/devstack.sh up, then run node scripts/review/journey.mjs --plan scripts/review/plan-showcase.json --base http://127.0.0.1:<port> --out /tmp/showcase, then copy the showcase-*.png files to landing/assets/showcase/ and assets/showcase/. Re-run on UI changes to dashboard, server detail, studio, or modpacks. Credentials from PANEL_REVIEW_USER / PANEL_REVIEW_PASSWORD only; never commit PNGs you did not generate from a live stack.
